name: Hitachi’s DELTA fin transistor
description: At Hitachi’s Central Research Laboratory in Kokubunji, Digh Hisamoto, Toru Kaga, Yoshifumi Kawamoto and Eiji Takeda fabricated and measured an ultrathin silicon-on-insulator MOS transistor. Its channel ran along the sides of a narrow upright silicon fin. Gates acting from both sides controlled the thin channel as device dimensions shrank.

date.basis: The 1989 International Electron Devices Meeting proceedings contain the experimental report.

events.statement: Hitachi researchers reported their fully depleted lean-channel transistor (DELTA) and experimental results at IEDM.

evidence.locator: Printed pp. 833–835, abstract, device structure and measured characteristics
evidence.supports: Hisamoto, Kaga, Kawamoto and Takeda at Hitachi describe fabricating and measuring the ultrathin vertical SOI device.

evidence.locator: Printed pp. 36–37, Introduction and Device Characteristics
evidence.supports: The journal paper documents electrical control from both fin faces and measured device behaviour.

earliest_record.rationale: The 1989 conference paper reports already fabricated and measured devices. The date here is the public report.
